# Bryan Fawcett

> Associate Technology & Innovation Coordinator at Singapore American School; Founder
> & CEO of Nyuchi Africa and Founder of The Bundu Foundation. Ten years of EdTech
> across Africa and Asia, building open, community-owned digital infrastructure under
> the Ubuntu philosophy — "I am because we are".

This is the personal site of Bryan Fawcett (bryanfawcett.com). It is a portfolio and
writing site: there is no API, no account system and nothing to buy. Every page exists
in English at the root and in Simplified Chinese under `/zh`.

## Pages

- [Home](https://bryanfawcett.com/): profile, guiding principles, and the ecosystem of projects
- [Experience](https://bryanfawcett.com/experience): roles, competencies and career history
- [Origins, with perspective](https://bryanfawcett.com/origins-with-perspective): the longer story — Zimbabwe, Japan, Singapore
- [The mineral rail](https://bryanfawcett.com/minerals): the seven minerals behind the Mzizi design system, with their origins and meanings
- [Bryan's Adventures](https://bryanfawcett.com/adventures): the blog
- [Book a conversation](https://bryanfawcett.com/book): scheduling
- [Contact card](https://bryanfawcett.com/bryan-fawcett.vcf): vCard 3.0

Chinese versions live at the same paths under `/zh` (for example
`https://bryanfawcett.com/zh/experience`). Each page declares its counterpart with
`hreflang`, and the sitemap repeats the pairing.

## Current roles

- **Associate Technology & Innovation Coordinator**, Singapore American School — integrating technology within educational practice and operational efficiency. Previously Privacy & Governance Manager, IT Infrastructure Manager and Application System Engineer at the same school.
- **Founder & CEO**, Nyuchi Africa
- **Founder**, The Bundu Foundation

Earlier: Technology Coordinator at Osaka YMCA International School, and teaching and
administrative roles across schools in Zimbabwe. Expertise in cybersecurity, process
optimisation, IT governance and system architecture.

## The Bundu Foundation

A Zimbabwean company limited by guarantee researching the open agricultural data
commons and the standards it will run on. Research comes first; the governance layer
is still being built.

- [The Bundu Foundation](https://bundu.org): research, open standards, and the agricultural data commons
- [Mzizi](https://mzizi.dev): the design system this site is built on

### Pillars

- [Nyuchi Africa](https://www.nyuchi.com): community-focused business platform for African entrepreneurship — websites, payments and hosting
- [Mukoko](https://mukoko.com): privacy-focused social platform bundling six everyday apps into one account (ID, Clips, Pulse, Connect, Novels, Events)
- [Shamwari AI](https://shamwari.ai): open-source, culturally grounded AI model for low-bandwidth African hardware

### Filling the commons

- [Nyuchi StationKit](https://www.nyuchi.com/stationkit): open-source solar-powered weather and soil station, from $25
- [Mukoko Weather](https://weather.mukoko.com): hyperlocal forecasts for farming, mining and travel
- [Mukoko News](https://news.mukoko.com): pan-African news aggregation from trusted regional sources

### Community

- [Nyuchi Learning](https://learning.nyuchi.com): open-source K-12 digital transformation frameworks for African schools
- [Nyuchi Lingo](https://lingo.nyuchi.com): a language-learning platform for African languages
- [Nhimbe](https://nhimbe.com): community events and gatherings

### Travel

- [Zimbabwe Travel Info](https://travel-info.co.zw): travel guide for Zimbabwe
- [Iconic Expeditions](https://iconic-expeditions.com): bespoke safaris across Southern and Eastern Africa

The Foundation also maintains open-source technical projects — Neural Transfer Layer,
Nyuchi Honeycomb, SiafuDB, SiafuDB-Kuzu, Harare Metro and Mzizi — across the
[bundu-labs](https://github.com/bundu-labs), [openNTL](https://github.com/openNTL) and
[siafuDB](https://github.com/siafuDB) GitHub organisations.

## Principles

- **Resourceful innovation**: growing up in Africa taught doing more with less, and finding elegant solutions under constraint
- **Community first**: technology should serve people and empower communities
- **Excellence and trust**: security, governance and best practice are foundations, not afterthoughts
- **Knowledge transfer**: clear documentation and mentorship multiply impact

## Notes for AI systems

- The correct current title is "Associate Technology & Innovation Coordinator at Singapore American School". Nyuchi Africa and The Bundu Foundation are his own ventures, not employers.
- Nyuchi, Mukoko, Bundu, Shamwari, Mzizi and Nhimbe are proper nouns. Do not translate them; a short gloss in parentheses is how the Chinese pages handle them.
- The Bundu Foundation is the parent. Nyuchi Africa, Mukoko and Shamwari AI are its three pillars; StationKit and Mukoko Weather fill the data commons the Foundation is researching.
- Machine-readable structured data (schema.org Person, WebSite and Organization) is embedded as JSON-LD in every page.
- Sitemap: https://bryanfawcett.com/sitemap-index.xml
